root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: the `if (!tmp_str[i]) break;` condition must become true before `gf_strdup(tmp_str)` may execute
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Immediately after the movie_identifier copy loop and before `gf_strdup(tmp_str)`, `abst_box_read()` must know that the loop satisfied its explicit `if (!tmp_str[i]) break;` terminator condition rather than exhausting `tmp_strsize` on nonzero bytes.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original records `terminator_seen=0` at the post-loop guard and still executes the protected movie_identifier `gf_strdup` call, so the heap buffer is forwarded without any observed NUL terminator. The fixed code makes that source-level obligation explicit and suppresses the protected call until the loop has actually seen a zero byte.

nodes.state: At the project sink `gf_strdup`, `STRDUP(str)` receives the same `tmp_str` heap buffer from `abst_box_read()` and therefore scans that buffer with C-string semantics.

At the post-loop guard, `i` equals the pre-loop movie_identifier buffer capacity, so the vulnerable execution has overwritten every byte of the zero-filled `tmp_str` allocation with nonzero input before considering `gf_strdup`.

edges.relation: The exact `tmp_str` pointer that survives the vulnerable movie_identifier guard is passed unchanged into `gf_strdup` as the `str` argument.
